section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the psychometric properties of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) in Brazilian adolescents. The study found a one-dimensional factor structure for the BAS-2 that was invariant across gender, with adequate internal consistency and high temporal stability. The instrument demonstrated convergent and incremental validity through negative correlations with BMI and social physique anxiety, and positive correlations with life satisfaction, with boys showing moderately higher body appreciation scores than girls after controlling for weight status.
